name: add_highlight
title: Add Highlight
description: Add a background or foreground color highlight to a region in the hex editor. Highlights are visible in the ImHex GUI and help agents visually mark interesting regions for human review or for tracking across sessions.

address.description: Start address of the region to highlight

size.description: Size of the region in bytes

color.description: RGBA color value (e.g., 0xFF0000FF for red, 0x00FF00FF for green, 0x0000FFFF for blue, 0xFFFF00FF for yellow). Defaults to red.

type.description: Whether to highlight the background or foreground of bytes. Defaults to 'background'.

id.description: Unique ID of the created highlight
